title: The Mixed Alphabet Alibi
description:
An encrypted alibi note was recovered from Evidence Folder #7.
The note uses the ancient Atbash substitution cipher (A=Z, B=Y, C=X).
question:
Decode this Atbash cipher:

GSV ERXGRN DZH KLISLMVW
acceptable_answer_format:
Type the decoded sentence exactly.

Example:
THE KEY IS SAFE
hints: Atbash flips the alphabet completely: A becomes Z, B becomes Y, C becomes X.
G maps to T, S maps to H, V maps to E.
Translate each letter with its opposite twin from the reverse alphabet.
solution_explanation: Applying Atbash reverse-alphabet substitution (G->T, S->H, V->E...) yields 'THE VICTIM WAS POISONED'.
